Molly and Grandma were walking through the town. Molly was very sad and she kept looking down. Grandma asked her why she was feeling so blue. Molly said, "My toy is broken and now I'm feeling so guilty, too."

Grandma said, "My dear, I know something that will make you feel much better. I know of a special place where broken toys can be traded."

Molly's eyes lit up. She said, "Really? Can we go there now?" Grandma smiled and said, "Yes, but we must hurry!"

They soon arrived at the toy store. Molly was amazed by all the different toys she saw. She chose a brand new doll and couldn't wait to take it home.

Grandma asked, "Are you happy now, sweetie?" Molly nodded and gave her a big hug. She said, "Thank you so much, Grandma. I'm so happy!"

Grandma hugged her back and wiped away a few of Molly's tears of joy. Molly was so relieved, she was no longer feeling guilty, and the sadness was all gone. Grandma smiled and said, "That's what trade is all about!"

Once upon a time, there was a prince. He was on a mission to find a magical treasure. On the way, he stumbled upon a mountain. As he looked upon the mountain, he saw a precious gem drop down from the top. It was sparkling in the sunlight!

The prince was so excited that he ran up the mountain to get the gem. Just as he was about to reach it, a giant eagle flew down and snatched it up. The prince was so envious!

He shouted out, "Hey eagle! Please give me back my gem!"

The eagle laughed and replied, "Go away prince! I see this shiny treasure and I want it for myself! You're not getting it back!"

The prince was very sad, but he didn't give up. He thought of a plan. He shouted out, "Wait, eagle! I could give you something even better!"

The eagle didn't believe the prince, but he asked anyway, "What could you possibly give me that's better than this gem?"

The prince replied, "I could give you something even shinier and more precious. Do you want to find out what it is?"

The eagle was intrigued and said, "Yes, show me!"

The prince then reached beneath his cape and pulled out a beautiful diamond necklace. The eagle was so amazed that it dropped the gem and flew away with the necklace.

Once there was a famous flower. He lived in a garden with lots of other flowers. Every day he watched them bloom in beautiful colors, but he couldn't bloom himself. 

One day, a boy named Danny came to the garden. He had a bag of coal with him. He put some coal around the flower and then said, â€œMaybe this will help you bloom!â€ 

The flower was so excited! He felt funny, and then he started to slowly bloom. Bright pink petals appeared around him and soon he was more beautiful than any other flower in the garden.

Danny smiled and said, â€œI knew you could do it!â€ 

The flower was so happy. From that day on, he bloomed every day in the garden and was known as the most famous flower!

The windy day was quiet and still. Little Timmy decided to take a walk. As he walked he found something smelly. It was a box! Curious, he opened it to explore. Suddenly a giant dragon flew out of the box! Timmy was so scared, he stood there and couldn't move.

"RRAAAAAAAAWR!" The dragon bellowed.

"I am here to strike!"

Timmy was so scared, he didn't know what to do. Suddenly he heard a wise old voice. It said,

"Do not be afraid, Timmy. Strike the dragon with your courage."

So Timmy gathered up all his courage and shouted,

"No! You will not strike me!"

The dragon was so surprised. He flew away, never to be seen again.

The windy day was quiet again and Timmy felt proud of his bravery.

Once there was a little girl called Tilly. She had a box of toys she liked to play with. One day she wanted to play with her toys, but her mom said no.

"Tilly, we have to delay the fun for now," Mom said.
"But why?" Tilly asked, feeling weak.
"We have to go to the store first," said her mom.

Tilly was upset, but she came along with her mom to the store. She wanted to go home and get back to playing with her box of toys.

At the store, Tilly saw a lot of interesting things. She was so happy to be out and about, she forgot about her box of toys at home. 

When they got home, Tilly ran to the box of toys and laughed as she played with them. 

Mom smiled, relieved that Tilly was happy and had forgotten about the delay.

Once, there was a little girl who wanted to go home. She thought about it every day. She was very flexible, so she decided to make her own way home.

She went outside and first she looked for wheels to put on her feet. Then, she gathered some string to tie them on. She was so excited!

When she was finished she said to herself, "Now I can go home!" As she started walking she heard a noise. It was her mom calling her.

She stopped and said, "Mom, I'm thinking of making my own way home!" Her mom laughed. "That sounds like a great idea, honey. Let me help you!"

Together, they built an even better way home. The little girl was so happy. Now she could go home whenever she wanted.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Fido. He loved to play in the sun and feel the warm heat. Every day he would run around with his friends and enjoy being in the sunshine. 

One day, Fido and his friends heard about a big hard hill. They all wanted to climb it. Fido said, "Let's go! I bet it will be fun to go up the hill."

So, they all started climbing the big hard hill. Fido was getting tired from going up so fast. But his friends were very brave and kept going.

Finally, they reached the top of the hill. They were so happy and enjoyed the view. They all laughed and hugged each other. 

When it was time to go back down, Fido said, "Let's slide down the hill! That will be more fun." So, they all had a great time going down the hill, feeling the heat of the sun on their faces. 

At the end of the day, Fido and his friends were all very tired but very happy. They had enjoyed their fun adventure!

Once there lived a zebra. He was very lonely and he had no one to keep him company. One day, the zebra decided to make a friend so he took his paintbrush and painted a beautiful picture of a creature with a long neck, stripes, and a happy face.

The zebra said aloud, "You shall be my new friend." The painted friend nodded in agreement. 

The zebra and his painted friend painted in the grass together casting beautiful colors across the meadow. Pinks, blues, and greens mixed together. The zebra was so happy with his new companion that he danced and smiled in the sunlight.

One day, a kind bank came by to check on the zebra. She was moved by the sight of the two friends laughing and playing together and with a gentle voice she said, "That is the most compassionate act I have ever seen." 
The zebra smiled and nodded proudly. His painted friend smiled back.

And so the zebra and his painted friend lived in the meadow, playing and painting together every day. The zebra was never lonely again.

Once upon a time, there was a happy little boy named Timmy. Timmy was really busy every day, and he loved to whistle as he went on his adventures. 

One day, as Timmy was walking along whistling, he heard a funny sound. He looked around, but he couldnâ€™t see what was making the noise. Suddenly, he heard the noise again - it sounded like a whistle! 

Timmy followed the sound and eventually he spotted a tiny bird on top of a fence. The bird was making the whistle noise! Timmy was so excited that he decided to whistle back. 

The bird chirped one more time then it flew away. Timmy was so happy that he decided to count how many times the bird had chirped. He counted one, two, three - three whole numbers!

"Three numbers! Thatâ€™s amazing," Timmy said out loud, smiling. He felt so proud of himself for counting the numbers and all his hard work. He was so busy, but it was worth it.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Chad. He was visiting his grandmother's house and wanted to be able to help her make some yummy cookies. Unfortunately, Chad was not very good at baking and he kept making mistakes.

He dropped the dough too hard on the counter, and it spilled everywhere. His grandmother got very angry and slapped him on the arm. Chad felt really upset and started to cry.

His grandmother said, "It's OK, Chad. It was an accident. I shouldn't have been so rude to you." 

They hugged and decided to start fresh. This time, Chad was careful to measure the ingredients exactly and rolled the dough very gently.

Finally, when the cookies were done, everyone was very happy and proud that Chad had done such a great job!

Once upon a time there was an old lady who lived in a big, white house. She had a big garden with lots of tasty, ripe fruit. 

One day a small, furry creature came to her door. The old lady said hello and the creature said it was very hungry. 

The old lady smiled and said, "My name is Grandma, what is yours?"

The small creature said, "My name is Toto. Can you please provide me some food?" 

Grandma said, "Of course I can! Let's pick some of my white pear and fresh apples to share."

And so Toto and Grandma enjoyed a feast of white pears and red apples. They had so much fun sharing stories and eating together. 

Grandma said, "You are always welcome here Toto!"

Toto thanked Grandma and promised to come back soon.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who wanted to go on a big adventure. She had to pack all her things so she asked her mom for help.

â€œMom, how do I pack for my adventure?â€ the little girl asked.

â€œFirst, you will need to find a bag thatâ€™s big enough for all your stuff,â€ her mom said.

The little girl found a big black bag and started to pack it. She put her clothes, shoes and some food inside. She also put in some wheat because she wanted to have something to eat during her journey.

â€œThere! I packed all my things,â€ she said.

â€œGreat job!â€ her mom said. â€œNow you are ready for your adventure.â€

The little girl was so happy. She said goodbye to her mom and went out on her big adventure.

The little girl showed her dolly to her mom. She was smiling and showing off the new dress she had put on the dolly.

Mommy looked at the dolly and smiled. "It looks very nice, sweetheart," she said.

The little girl nodded excitedly. She wanted to show mommy something else.

"Mommy! Look," she said and ran to the kitchen. She took a carton of milk from the fridge. "This is reliable milk," she said.

Mommy laughed. "Yes, it is reliable. You did a good job picking it out," she said.

The little girl smiled and ran off to play with her dolly again. Mommy had shown her how to choose reliable milk for her dolly to drink, and she was proud of her accomplishment.

Jim was the bravest astronaut! He was the first one to record a moonwalk. He put on his spacesuit, adjusted his helmet and took a giant step out of the spaceship. As he floated in the air, he could see the Earth, twinkling in the night sky. 

Jim took in a deep breath. He had oxygen in his suit, so he wasn't worried. He extended his arm and waved. It was a fierce moment! He shouted "Hello, Earth!" 

Back on the spaceship, his crew were cheering and recording the moment. They were so proud of their brave friend! Jim smiled and waved to them one more time before floating back to the spaceship. 

Jim exclaimed "That was awesome! I can't believe I recorded a moonwalk!" 

His crew nodded in agreement and looked at their brave friend with admiration. Jim had done it! He had recorded a brave moonwalk and made history.

Once upon a time, there lived a very curious girl called Lucy. One day, she asked her mum a million questions. She wanted to know everything there was to know. 

Mum laughed and said, "Let me show you something that will help you answer all your questions." 

Mum took Lucy to a special room and gave her a microscope. Lucy was thrilled! She put the microscope on the table and peered in. 

"Ooh, what do I see?" she asked.

"It looks like a spicy pepper," Mum replied.

Lucy got even more excited. She examined the pepper closely with the microscope.

"It has little black seeds!" Lucy exclaimed. 

"Yes, and those seeds are what make the pepper spicy," Mum explained.

Lucy smiled and said, "Now I can answer all my questions!" 

Mum smiled too, happy that her daughter was so curious.

Grandpa and Noah were very excited. Grandpa had something for Noah to unpack. Noah smiled. He knew it would be something special.

"What is it, Grandpa?" he asked.

"It's a surprise!" Grandpa said. 

Grandpa opened the box and Noah carefully unpacked it. Inside was a gentle, juicy pear.

"I love pears, Grandpa!" Noah said.

Grandpa smiled. "I thought you would. You can have it as a snack, sweetheart." 

So Noah ate the pear. It was sweet, juicy and delicious. Noah was very happy. 

"Thank you, Grandpa!" he said with a big smile on his face. 

Grandpa hugged him. "You're welcome, my love. I'm so glad you liked it."

Once upon a time there was a little cabin in the woods. Inside the cabin was a young girl named Jane. She had lots of things in her room, including a big drawer. She opened it and saw many smooth things inside.

"Oh wow!" she said. "These things feel so smooth!"

Jane took out one of the smooth objects and carefully looked at it. She saw that it was a little toy car. She started pushing it around her room and it made her smile.

The more Jane played with it, the more fun she had. She eventually decided that she wanted more things like it. So, she started filling the drawer with more smooth things. She increased the number of smooth toys inside and very soon the drawer was full of them. 

"Wow, that's a lot of smooth toys!" Jane said happily. 

From then on, Jane was never bored. She had many smooth toys to play with and it kept her happy for hours on end.

Sharon was walking in the park when she heard a loud scream. She was frightened and stopped in her tracks. She could tell the scream had come from the pond nearby. Sharon walked closer and saw a little girl playing in the water with a bottle.

The girl was shivering and seemed very scared. Sharon asked her what was wrong and the girl said she had dropped her bottle in the water and couldn't get it out. Sharon smiled and said she could help. She reached in and grabbed the bottle.

The girl was so relieved. She hugged Sharon and thanked her. Sharon said she was happy to help. She tucked the bottle under her arm and they walked home together. Sharon was glad she was able to make the little girl stop screaming.

Once upon a time, there was a cute little girl named Lily. She had a lot of energy and loved to explore the world around her.

One day, Lily was walking through the park and saw something very attractive. It was a shiny red car that was ready to zoom across the park. She had never seen a car like this before and wanted to ride in it.

Lily walked up to the car and said, "Hi! Can I have a ride?" 

The car driver looked at her and said, "Sure! Hop in and I'll take you around the park."

Lily was so excited. She strapped herself in, and the car zoomed around the park. The wind blew in her face and the sun shone on her skin. Lily had never felt so happy.

When it was time to go home, Lily thanked the car driver and said, "That was fun!" 

The car driver smiled and waved goodbye as the car zoomed away.

Jack was a 3 year old boy who loved ice-cream. Every week his mommy would take him to the store to buy him his favorite treat. But today, he saw something different - a fancy ice-cream with lots of sprinkles and chocolate syrup on top. He wanted to try it but he didn't know if it was his kind of ice-cream.

Jack asked his mommy: "Does this ice-cream belong to me?" 

His mommy smiled and said "Yes, this ice-cream belongs to you. You can try it if you like."

Jack was so excited he jumped up and down. He couldn't wait to have a taste of the fancy ice-cream. He grabbed the cone and happily licked the creamy goodness. 

It was delicious! Jack knew this fancy ice-cream definitely belonged to him.

Once upon a time, there lived an old man who really loved the sea. Every day, he went to the beach to find all sorts of things. One day, he found a pretty crab. He put it in a pail and took it home.

When the old man got home, he showed the crab to his three-year-old granddaughter. She recognized the crab right away. The old man smiled and said, "Do you know what kind it is?"

The little girl was very excited. She said, "It's a sand crab. It's so pretty!"

The old man laughed and said, "Yes, it sure is. Would you like to keep it as a pet?"

The little girl's face lit up. She said, "Yes, please! I'll look after it and give it a nice home."

The old man beamed with pride. He gave the little girl the crab and she took it home. From then on, she and the crab were best friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jane. Jane liked to go swimming at the pool. She went swimming with her mom every Saturday. 

One Saturday, Jane accidentally got her hair wet. Her mom said, "Oh no, we need to get shampoo and clean up that wet hair." 

Then, Jane and her mom went to the store and bought some shampoo. 

When they got home, Jane's mom filled the bathtub with warm water and bubbles. She gently put some shampoo in Jane's hair and started to massage her head. Jane felt so cozy and relaxed. 

After Jane's hair was nice and clean, she and her mom hugged. The hug was so comforting and warm. 

Jane said, "I love swimming, mom!" 

Her mom replied, "Me too, sweetheart!"

Jackie was eager to go to the park. She wanted to explore the fun things to do there. Suddenly, Jackie heard something coming from the playground. She couldn't believe what she heard - it was a monster! Jackie was so scared she wanted to run away. But then she decide to be brave.

"Hello?" Jackie said with a trembling voice.

The monster replied, "Hello Jackie, don't be scared of me. I'm a friendly monster. Would you like to play with me?"

Jackie was still a bit scared, but she decided to be brave and said, "Yes, I'd like to play with you."

So Jackie and the monster played hide and seek and tag until it was time to go home. Jackie was sad to say goodbye to her new friend, but she was so happy that she made the brave decision to play with the monster.

Once upon a time there was a mystery. It was very big and very scary. Everyone was scared to take a look.

One day Jack was walking past the mystery and he stopped. He thought to himself, â€œI want to know whatâ€™s inside.â€

He stepped closer and closer until he was right in front of it. He called out, â€œHello? Is anyone there?â€

Suddenly he heard a voice. It said, â€œYes, Iâ€™m here. What do you want to know?â€

Jack was not sure what to say. He thought for a minute and then he asked, â€œWhat is inside the mystery?â€

The voice answered, â€œThat is something you must find out for yourself.â€

So Jack tried. He took a deep breath, squinted his eyes, and stepped into the mystery. After a few minutes he came back out and he was smiling. He had solved the mystery!

Everyone was amazed. Jack had found the answer! They cheered for him and thanked him for being brave enough to answer the mystery.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Luke and Sarah. Today, they were going to the theater.

They were so excited! They ran. They hopped. They stretched their arms up high. 

When they arrived, they saw a big, rough theater. They said, "Wow!" 

Luke asked Sarah, "Do you want to stretch our legs too?" She said, "Yea!" 

So they stretched and ran around the theater. What fun they had! They laughed and smiled. 

When they were done, they agreed it was the best day ever. Then they went home, smiling ear to ear.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Sally. She was three years old and loved discovering new things.

One day, Sally went for a walk with her mom. As they walked, Sally spotted a magnet in a puddle. The magnet was wet. Sally wanted to pick it up but her mom said, "No Sally, it might scare you!"

But Sally was brave and she said, "I'm not scared! I want to pick it up!" 

Her mom said, "I won't let you pick it up, it's a silly thing to do. It's safe to admire it from far away". 

Sally thought for a moment and then agreed. So, Sally and her mom watched the magnet from afar and then carried on with their walk.

Once upon a time, there was a famous, long haired princess. Her hair was so beautiful that it even made grown-up kings and queens jealous!

One day, the princess decided to go to the market. She told her mom, "I am going to the market". When she was finished shopping, the princess visited a magical castle. Inside, she met a fairy and they became fast friends.

The fairy asked the princess, "What can I do to serve you today?" The princess answered, "I would love to have a new hairstyle".

The fairy smiled and said, "I will be more than happy to serve you". She waved her wand and the princess' hair changed into an even more beautiful style. 

The princess was so excited about her new hair! "Thank you so much for serving me," she said to the fairy. 

The fairy replied, "You are so welcome! I am glad to make you even more famous!" The fairy and the princess laughed and hugged. Together, they went for a walk in the beautiful, magical forest.

Once upon a time, a naughty bird called Toby was walking around the forest. He saw a beautiful feather in the grass. He picked it up and admired how it shone in the sun.

Suddenly, Toby heard a voice. It was a rabbit, who said "Hey, that feather is mine! Don't take it." Toby was a bit scared, but he trusted the rabbit. He explained that he was admiring the feather and would give it back.

"I can trust you, can't I?", asked the rabbit. Toby nodded happily and gave it back.

The rabbit smiled and told Toby "Thank you for trusting me. As a reward, here is a special feather just for you."

Toby was so excited about the new feather. He thanked the rabbit before running off to show his friends. From that day on, Toby trusted others and was always kind to them!

Once there was a mom and a dad and a little boy who was three years old. His mom said to him, "It's time to go on vacation!"

The little boy was so excited! He asked his mom, "Where are we going on vacation?"

Mom said, "We're going to a place with thick green trees and a big pond."

Later that day, the mom and dad and the little boy went on vacation. The dad said, "Let's play by the pond and be careful to not get too close."

The mom cheered, "Yes! Let's make sure we protect each other"

The little boy led the way. He laughed when he saw the big, thick trees. He ran around and felt so happy!

Maybe next time, they can go on vacation again!

Once upon a time, there was a bird called Joe. Joe was a very obedient bird, who always listened to his mom.

One day, Joe asked his mom, "Can I fly really high today?" His mom said, "Yes, go ahead."

So Joe flew high and higher. He was so happy, and he kept flying. Soon, he was so far away!

When Joe stopped flying, he looked around and he noticed he didn't recognise anything. He wasn't sure where he was.

Then, out of the corner of his eye, he saw another bird. "What's your name?" Joe asked.

The other bird said, "My name is Blue. Where are you from?"

Joe told Blue that he had flown far away. Blue said, "Let me show you the way back."

So Blue and Joe flew together until they reached Joe's home. Joe thanked Blue and said goodbye.

As Joe flew home, he was so happy he had such a good friend. He looked forward to their next adventure together.

Once upon a time there was a famous wall. All the people in the neighbourhood would talk about how special it was.

One day, a little girl named Sarah was walking past, when she heard two voices coming from the wall. She stopped to listen, and realised that it was coming from a cat and a bird who were both sitting on the wall.

The cat said to the bird, "I want to be famous too!"

The bird replied, "You already are famous! Everyone in the neighbourhood talks about how special you are."

Sarah smiled and continued on her way, feeling lucky that she had heard the conversation.

Jim was a very curious three year old, who always asked lots of questions. His mum had alerted him to be careful not to touch the ashtray in the living room.

"Why not, mum," Jim asked.

"Because it's very hot," she answered.

Jim decided he would mail the ashtray to make sure it was safe. He carefully put it in a box, wrote an address on it and gave it to the postman.

The next day when he woke up, he was so excited. He ran to the mailbox, opened it and found a bigger box with a mild smell. Jim knew it must be the ashtray!

He brought it inside, showed it to his mum and hugged it. It was the best way he ever thought of to keep the ashtray safe.

Jack and Jill were playing in the park one day. Jack saw a big pile of sugar on the ground and started to reach for it. Jill saw this and quickly warned Jack, "No! That sugar will make you sick! Don't touch it".

Jack listened to Jill and didn't touch the sugar. He asked, "What CAN I touch, then?"

Jill thought for a moment and then said, "You can touch the flowers, the slide and the swings. They are all useful and good for you!"

So, Jack and Jill spent the afternoon playing on the swings, going down the slide and smelling the flowers. They had lots of fun, and Jack remembered never to touch the sugar!

Anna was a very cheerful girl. She especially loved playing outside. One day, while Anna was playing in the garden, her mum came and called her inside.

Anna said, "Mum, why? I'm having so much fun!"

Mum smiled and said, "Anna, I need you to help me lift a blouse out of the cupboard. Will you come and help?"

Anna was very excited to help, so she followed her mum inside. Mum lifted the blouse from the cupboard and showed Anna.

"Now," said Mum, "Can you help me lift the blouse on my bed?"

Anna was eager to help, so she reached up and together with her mum, they lifted the blouse onto the bed.

When it was done, Anna said, "There!", feeling very proud of her work. 

Mum smiled and said, "Well done, Anna. You did a great job."

Anna was very cheerful as she gave her mum a big hug. She was so glad she had helped.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Sam. He was three years old and liked to play with his friends.

One day, Sam and his friends were playing hide and seek in the park. All of a sudden, Sam saw something shiny in the grass. It was a big, yellow lemon! He wanted to pick it up, but he knew he shouldn't.

He ran back to his friends and asked if anyone knew whose lemon it was. His friend Petey said, "I think it's Mrs. Smith's lemon tree. She won't be happy if you take it!"

Sam felt guilty, but he couldn't resist the temptation. He slowly gained the lemon and put it in his pocket.

Sam continued to play with his friends, but he couldn't stop thinking about the lemon. After a while, he decided to do the right thing and take the lemon back to Mrs. Smith.

When Sam got to Mrs. Smith's house, she was very pleased. She said, "Thank you for being a good person, Sam. You did the right thing."

Sam smiled. He was glad that he learned that it's always better to do the right thing.

Maia and Mom were walking down the street, admiring the tidy gardens. Maia saw a butterfly flitting from one bush to the next.

"Mom," she said, pointing, "look, pretty!"

Mom smiled at her. "Yes indeed. It is beautiful, isn't it ?"

Maia nodded and asked, "Will you carry me?"

Mom picked her up and put her on her shoulder. Maia giggled and asked, "Where are we going?"

"To the park, silly!" Mom said, tickling her.

But when they got to the park, Maia wasn't sure what to do. She looked around and asked, "What can I play with, Mom ?"

Mom pointed to a slide, a swing, and a jungle gym. "There's lots of fun things here! Why don't you start by tidying up your toys when you're done?"

Maia nodded and went to explore. She had the best time playing until it was time to go home. When they arrived, Mom asked, "Did you have a good time?"

Maia smiled and said, "Yes, it was lots of fun! Let's come back soon!"

Mama and Papa were out walking when they saw a very tall tower. They thought it looked so tall that they couldn't even see the top. They asked a man who was bald to tell them how tall it was.

The man said, "My tower is so tall that it reaches the clouds, so no one can measure it."

Mama and Papa were amazed. Papa said, "I bet it must have taken a long time to build that tower!"

The man explained, "We worked very hard to build it. It took us many weeks."

Just then, a mailman came by and delivered a package to the bald man. Mama and Papa watched as he opened it. Inside was a shiny new hat.

The man was so happy to receive it. He put it on and said, "Now my head won't be so bald!" Mama and Papa laughed. Mama said, "There you go, now you have a hat to match the tower!"

Once upon a time, there was a young girl named Amy. She wanted to go for a walk, so she put on her coat and set out. As she walked through the park, she noticed something peculiar - a chain was lying on the ground.

She wanted to find out what it was, so she picked it up and examined it. When she looked closely, she was surprised - it was very heavy. She decided to take it home with her.

When Amy got back to her house, she went to the kitchen and placed the chain on the counter. She tugged on it, to see how strong it was, but the chain wouldnâ€™t budge. Suddenly, Amy's mom walked in and asked, "What are you doing?"

Amy replied, "I found a chain, it's really strong!"

Her mom said, "That's great! But, it looks really dirty and I don't know if it's safe. Let's throw it away, it looks disgusting!"

Amy agreed, and they both took the chain outside and threw it in the trash can. Later, Amy found a pretty bracelet to take with her on her next walk.

Once upon a time there was a clever bunny. His name was Jack. He had a special weapon which he used to protect his friends.

One silly day, Jack was out walking in the forest with his friends. Suddenly, they heard a loud noise! What was it? 

"Let me take a look," said Jack bravely. So he bravely grabbed his weapon and ran off to the source of the noise. 

He found a giant monster! It was big and very scary. The monster shouted, "I will get you!" 

But Jack bravely held up his weapon and shouted back, "No, you won't! I will protect my friends!" 

The monster saw that Jack was brave. He knew that he had met his match! So the monster turned and ran away.

Jack had saved the day! His silly weapon had protected his friends from the giant monster. From then on, Jack was a hero.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Jack. He was very excited because he was at the beach with his mom.

The sun was shining and the sea was very calm. Jack saw a big, blue wave rolling in and asked, "Mom, can I go and play?"

Mama nodded, "Yes, be careful. Have fun!"

Jack hopped on the sand and danced, spinning and twirling around on his toes. He laughed as the wind blew through his hair, like a big hug.

Then, he heard something. Jack turned and saw a pretty, pink kite flying above him. He waved at it and shouted, "Hi!"

The kite spun in circles above Jack's head. He smiled and felt so happy, like he was dancing in the sky.

Jack and the kite played together all afternoon. They spun together, over the sea and the smooth sand. 

"Bye-bye kite," Jack waved as the sun went down and it was time to go home.

The kite waved back, spinning one last time. Then it flew away, taking all of Jack's happy memories with it.
